data.body:
[P2] Set the termination flag before invoking shutdown callbacks

`terminate()` still invokes `setCheckpointTerminating` before setting `isTerminated`. The callback installed by `withDurableExecution` disables checkpoints and synchronously calls `terminated.abort()`. An abort listener that starts a step therefore reads `false` here and passes the new guard, even though its checkpoints are already being dropped. Its function can perform the unrecorded work this change intends to prevent. Move the flag assignment before the callback and add a regression that starts an operation synchronously from an abort listener.
